newsitem.title: USA: Tracor says Vitro subsidiary wins contract.
newsitem.headline: Tracor says Vitro subsidiary wins contract.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Thursday its subsidiary Vitro Corp won a $106.6 million contract from the naval sea systems command in Arlington, Va.
The company said the contract contains options for four additional years which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of the entire contract to $106,568,214.
The company said Vitro will provide management and technical support services for the program executive office for surface combatants/AEGIS program.
The company said AEGIS is a weapons and combat system. AEGIS cruisers and destroyers are part of the Navy's surface fleet.
Work will be performed by Vitro employees and their subcontractors located in Arlington, Va., and Rockville, Md.
